jobs.description:
We are looking for someone who is hands-on, commercially aware and comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial environment.

4to 6 years of experience in freight forwarding, logistics, shipping, transport or supply-chain operations.
Strong understanding of international freight and export/import processes.
Existing network of freight forwarders, carriers, transporters, customs brokers or logistics service providers.
Strong coordination and communication skills.
Good understanding of logistics documentation and shipment processes.
Strong Excel / Microsoft Office skills.
Excellent written and verbal Dutch & English.
Experience in the Rotterdam / Netherlands logistics market.
Knowledge of European customs procedures.

About the Opportunity: 
We are building our European operations from the ground up with Rotterdam as our base in the Netherlands. We are looking for an ambitious and hands-on Export Pricing & Operations Coordinator to join us at this exciting stage. 

You will be one of the first people on the ground.

You will work closely and directly with the management team to help establish our logistics operations in the Netherlands, from identifying and onboarding vendors, building relationships with freight partners to developing pricing, coordinating shipments, establishing processes and supporting customer requirements.

About The Company: 
We are an established global logistics and supply-chain organisation with extensive experience across freight forwarding, customs clearance, transportation, warehousing and international supply-chain solutions. We have offices across the globe - US, China, Dubai, Oman, Saudi, Singapore, Canada and 22 offices within India. 

As part of our international expansion, we are now establishing our European presence from Rotterdam.

Our ambition is to develop the Netherlands into an important operational and commercial hub for our European activities and build a strong, reliable network across Europe.

Main Responsibilities of the role:
Preparation and formulation of vaccines and pharmaceutical products.
Working with fixed and mobile brewing kettles up to 5000 liters.
Preparation, control and release of raw materials, filters and materials.
Execution of CIP and SIP processes on plants and equipment.
Registration of process steps and checks according to GMP and GDP guidelines.
Identifying and resolving deviations and process disruptions.
Collaborating with colleagues from production, quality, planning and technical operations.
Contributing to improvement projects and optimizations within the department.

Required Qualifications and skills
You love technology, processes and quality. You work accurately, take responsibility and enjoy achieving results together.
A completed MBO-3, MBO-4 or HBO education (e.g. MLO, MTS, VAPRO or similar).
Interest in engineering, process technology or pharmaceutical production.
A proactive and inquisitive attitude.
Good communication skills.
An eye for quality, safety and detail.
Experience within GMP, pharmaceuticals, food or process industry is a plus, but not a requirement.
Fluent in Dutch and English.

Our client is a global leader in medicines, dedicated to creating a healthy world. Through their vaccines, biologics, and medicines, they provide innovative treatments to improve the health of people and animals in more than 140 countries. They focus on conditions that severely impair daily functioning or are life-threatening, and for which new medicines are needed. Our client is also a pioneer in biologics research and development for animal health.

At our client, they believe in the power of diversity within teams of talented employees at all levels. Diverse skills, experiences, backgrounds, and cultural perspectives help them better understand the needs of their diverse customers, healthcare providers, and patients. Our client employs approximately 4,500 people across three locations in the Netherlands.

Main Responsibilities of the role:
Sorting received materials and checking them for accuracy, quality, and requested quantities.
Storing sorted materials by confirming their warehouse locations.
Order-picking secondary packaging materials using a handheld scanner according to the JIT principle (right material, quality, and quantities at the right time and place).
Checking and consolidating picked secondary packaging materials.
Sharing responsibility for maintaining a clean, safe, and professional work environment.
Ensuring storage equipment (pallet racks, warehouse shelving) and transport equipment (forklift, aerial work platform, stacker, and electric pallet truck) remain in good technical condition.
Proactively contributing to improvement proposals and/or improvement projects.
Taking personal responsibility for keeping personnel records up to date (e.g., TOJ, MyLearning, SBC training, development goals).

Minimum MBO-3 (vocational) level of education and proficiency, preferably supplemented by relevant certificates, training, and/or courses.
Possession of a forklift or electric pallet truck (EPT) certificate is an asset.
Logistics experience.
Knowledge of and experience with GMP is an asset.
Knowledge of safety (ergonomics, safety guidelines/SHE).
Team player.
Willingness to work overtime occasionally.
Flexibility towards their customers.
Fluent in Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: Housekeeping Management Intern - Park Plaza Victoria Amsterdam
jobs.description:
Feel the authentic.
Park Plaza Victoria Amsterdam is a historic and vibrant hotel, located opposite Amsterdam Central Station. Combining classic architecture with contemporary style, the hotel offers a dynamic environment where service excellence and attention to detail shape every guest experience.

As a Housekeeping Management Intern, you play a key role in supporting the Housekeeping team and ensuring high standards of cleanliness, presentation, and guest comfort across the hotel. You contribute to daily operations while developing leadership and organisational skills within a fast-paced hospitality environment.

This internship starts in September 2026 and offers a full-time learning experience for 5 to 12 months, aligned with your study requirements.

Responsibilities

• Support the supervision of daily housekeeping operations and team activities

• Assist in coordinating room cleaning schedules and public area maintenance

• Ensure cleanliness, quality, and brand standards are consistently maintained

• Support training and coaching of team members to achieve service excellence

• Assist with administrative tasks such as planning, reporting, and quality checks

• Monitor room status updates and communicate effectively with the Front Office

• Contribute ideas to improve efficiency, guest satisfaction, and team engagement

• Support stock control and inventory management for housekeeping supplies

Essential Requirements

• Currently enrolled in a hospitality, hotel management, or related study programme

• Strong communication skills in English, written and spoken

• Passion for hospitality and delivering high-quality guest experiences

• Proactive, organised, and eager to learn in a dynamic environment

• Strong attention to detail and a structured way of working

• Available for a full-time internship for 5 to 12 months

• Eligible to complete an internship in the Netherlands

Preferred Requirements

• Previous experience or strong interest in housekeeping
